def transform(grid):
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    # In these examples, color 5 is recolored to the other color; that other
    # color is replaced by 0.
    other = next((v for v in colors if v != 5), 0)
    return [[other if v == 5 else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
